project.name: Swiftdrop
project.description: A courier app for local shops, online couriers, and dispatch operations.

direction.palette: Appetizing warm (orange/red) + trust blue + map accent

app.name: Swiftdrop
app.tagline: On-demand local shop courier deliveries with real-time tracking

help.parcelSize: Size of package: small, medium, or large
help.proofPhoto: Mandatory photo of the delivered parcel at the door

help.isOnline: Toggle availability to receive new delivery offers

looks.reason: Vibrant, block-based styling tailored for on-demand couriers on phones.
Translucent glass cards providing a sleek, modern consumer delivery feel.
High contrast hairline flat design maximizing speed, legibility, and usability on mobile devices.

requested.words: practical and fast to use on a phone, high contrast, a bright orange accent

design.reason: A mobile-first workspace giving couriers and shop owners immediate clarity and high-contrast actions on the go.

tours.name: Parcel Order and Fulfillment
tours.outcome: The parcel is delivered to the customer with photographic proof

steps.title: Create delivery request (the delivery becomes offered). Rule: Must include pickup address, drop-off address, customer name, phone, and parcel size
Accept delivery offer (the delivery becomes assigned). Rule: Driver must be online, carry only one delivery at a time, and offer not already taken
Start traveling to pickup (the delivery becomes going_to_pickup)
Confirm parcel picked up (the delivery becomes picked_up)
Start traveling to drop-off (the delivery becomes going_to_dropoff)
Complete delivery with proof photo (the delivery becomes delivered). Rule: Photo of parcel at door is mandatory

tours.outcome: Customer stays informed of parcel delivery progress
